patterns.note: Sections frequently feature an asymmetrical split layout, pairing large, editorial-style photography with descriptive text blocks, often alternating sides down the page.
A large, decorative serif font is used for primary headings, creating an inviting and editorial tone, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The site uses a calming, earthy brand palette of greens and warm off-whites for backgrounds and UI, allowing vibrant, pattern-rich product photography to introduce the primary color accents.
Content sections and image grids reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The main navigation bar shrinks in height and the logo scales down subtly as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining a compact sticky header.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (earthy green and warm off-white) and distinct content groupings, often introduced by a large, evocative heading.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are used extensively to reveal content blocks and images with a staggered fade-up or subtle slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement. The hero image features a very subtle parallax effect, moving slightly slower than the foreground content. The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and reducing the logo size to create a more compact sticky header.

The site employs a flexible grid system to arrange large, high-quality images alongside descriptive text, often in asymmetrical or alternating two-column layouts, giving an editorial magazine-like feel.

A limited brand color palette is applied to UI elements and backgrounds, creating a cohesive and calming foundation that allows the vibrant, maximalist product photography to stand out as the primary source of visual interest and color.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, expressive serif headings (~3-4x body text) are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy and smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels, creating a clear hierarchy with a touch of editorial flair.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (mostly sharp corners on images and containers, with very slight rounding on input fields and buttons).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, especially in the hero, creating a relaxed and uncrowded feel).

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and maximalist aesthetic, achieved through the abundant use of vibrant, pattern-rich photography of interiors and products, set against a calming, earthy brand color palette. This creates a distinctive visual identity that feels both curated and inviting, moving beyond typical minimalist e-commerce by embracing a rich, layered visual experience.
